summary: Read several equations. Each equation divides one string variable by another and gives a positive floating quotient. Then read several questions, each also dividing one variable by another. Use the equations to compute every question. Write the floating result when it can be computed, and write -1.0 when it cannot. The input is valid, no divisor is 0, and the equations never conflict.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
